message.content:
This is a facial clay mask, which is a beauty or skin-care preparation. The natural heading is 3304, and the question is which subheading applies. 3304.99 covers "Other" preparations, and its 10-digit lines include 3304.99.5000, "Other: Other" (the former 3304.99.50 covers other beauty or skin care preparations not put up in packings for retail sale... ). I recall the current structure as:

- 3304.99.10 – Lip/eye... no, that's 3304.10 and 3304.20.
- 3304.91 – Powders.
- 3304.99.10 – Medicaments put up... no.
- 3304.99.20 – Anti-acne preparations. This is not right here.
- 3304.99.50 – Other.
- 3304.99.5000 – Other (includes face masks and creams).

CBP rulings on clay face masks classify them under 3304.99.5000, HTSUS, as "Beauty or make-up preparations and preparations for the care of the skin... Other: Other."
